returnBasis: PRICE_RETURN; outcome S1-S3/D1 weekly series t0->t1 (bar dates), S4 holdings return incl. exits; Q5-SPY against SPY at the same dates
availability: panel cutoff = day before rank date (filed < cutoff); rank date <= t0
stepDefinitions: S0 V10_PUBLISHED: docs/quant-recovery/v10/factor/factor-study-1.0.0.json (monthly, survivor frame, old market cap) - reference only
S1 FRAME_BEFORE: survivor frame listings with a panel row and a bar at t0; scores of the BEFORE panel as built; outcome = weekly series return t0 -> t1
S2 FRAME_AFTER: as S1 with the AFTER panel (corrected PIT market cap) -> market-cap effect
S3 SP_SERIES: S&P members with series and a panel row; scores re-normalised inside this subset (factors.cjs scoreCrossSection on AFTER raws); outcome weekly series -> population effect
S4 SP_HOLDINGS: same members and scores; outcome = holdings return incl. exits (ZERO / LOWER) -> exit/survivorship effect
D1 diagnostic: S&P members with series, AFTER full-frame scores (normalisation effect S3 vs D1)
D2 (registration 1.0.2, post hoc): S&P members with series, AFTER full-frame scores, holdings outcome incl. exits (ZERO / LOWER)
componentMinimum: factors.cjs UNIVERSE_MIN = 200 valid values per component (product contract) - inside the S&P subset profitability/composite are unavailable (S3/S4)
